description: This file defines the parent exception class 'DittoRuntimeException' used throughout the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides mechanisms for creating, serializing, and handling runtime exceptions with detailed error information, headers, and JSON serialization/deserialization support.

classes.name: DittoRuntimeException
classes.description: A parent class for all runtime exceptions in the Ditto framework, supporting JSON serialization, headers, error codes, and HTTP status integration.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the unique error code identifying this exception.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with this exception.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves the headers associated with this exception.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers, returning a new exception instance with updated headers.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this exception into a JSON object.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this exception into a JSON object using specified schema version and predicate.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object, headers, and builder.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a message string, headers, and builder.
